scope: Theorem 5.1 (Removal of seed controls) of the manuscript “QAOA attains the SK ground-state energy in the thermodynamic-first limit” (preprints/QAOA-attains-the-SK-ground-state-energy-in-the-thermodynamic-first-limit-September-25-2026/QAOA-attains-the-SK-ground-state-energy-in-the-thermodynamic-first-limit-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 281 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d07ebe181b03157), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite seeded word and every ϵ > 0, there is a finite ordinary cost–mixer word whose limiting tree energy differs from that of the seeded word by less than ϵ. Its angles are independent of the degree, the system size, and the disorder. In particular, the approximation uses the thermodynamic limit at a fixed word.
